ns2:course.label: System-On-Chip Design
ns2:course.description: Covers system-on-chip (SOC) design methodology and IP (intellectual property) reuse, system modeling and analysis, hardware/software co-design, behavioral synthesis, embedded software, reconfigurable computing, design verification and test, and design space exploration. Focusing on current SOC design and research topics, students are given opportunities to carry out class projects based on their own interests. Platform FPGA boards and digital cameras are provided to students to prototype, test, and evaluate their SOC designs. Prerequisite: ECE 391 and ECE 425.
